scope: WO-PERF A and window mutations in C
semantics: local penetration-thickness window, not whole-body Euclidean penetration depth PD
guarantees: axis certificate: an exact coordinate-axis translation of length w separates interiors, hence PD <= w
shell certificate: every strict overlap region lies in the certified body's radial shell of thickness <= w
PENETRATING in window mode does not imply PD > w
limitations: six-axis certificates depend on the coordinate frame
shorter oblique exits can be missed
rotation invariance is not guaranteed; L1-radius shell construction is also frame dependent
boundary_scale_cases: 18 single-axis gates: 6 signed axes x 3 scale/origin pairs; PD exactly w; engineering coordinate 1e6
shell_counterexample: two-wall key, half lengths (1,1/16,1/16), w=1/64, each overlap=3w/4; shell accepts despite independently proven PD>1
oblique_counterexample: boxes half lengths (1,4,4), PD=9/40 < w=1/4; exact z rotation cos=3/5 sin=4/5 causes all finite certificates to fail
